name: Arafo (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Arafo within a wreath (a book and a chevron on green and red).
history: The arms of Arafo were approved by decree 599/1975 of 13 March after deliberation of the Council of Ministers on 7 March 1975; by resolution of the full council of 30 August 2000 the municipality began the file requesting definitive approval of its official flag.

features.role: Arafo arms within a laurel wreath — book and chevron on green and red
